principles.name: Clarity before decoration
principles.rule: Visual choices must make hierarchy and action clearer.

principles.name: Accessible by construction
principles.rule: Interactive and text treatments must meet the configured accessibility baseline.

principles.name: Tokens over arbitrary values
principles.rule: Reusable UI must consume semantic tokens instead of introducing raw values.

principles.name: Explain every exception
principles.rule: Intentional deviations require an auditable decision record.
